audience: nursery groups that read rooms, staff and child records in eyworks

useCases.title: Find the nurseries of a company
useCases.text: List the companies your client can access. Then list the nurseries of one company with their guids.

useCases.title: Read the details of a nursery
useCases.text: Get one nursery with its address, contact, capacity, opening hours and tags. Get the company details for its legal data.

useCases.title: Check rooms and availability
useCases.text: List the rooms of a nursery with their capacity and age ranges. Read the nursery availability, which needs the availability scope.

useCases.title: Count active children at a nursery
useCases.text: List the child records of one nursery, with status and start and leave dates. Use the data only for the nursery's own purposes.

useCases.title: Review staff start and leave dates
useCases.text: List the employees of one nursery with their status, start date and leave date. Use the data only for the nursery's own purposes.
